notes: Runtime dispatch is preserved. The installed consumer records each implementation actually supported and exercised on the current CPU; timings are not compiler Benchmark scores.

Developer-mode CMake in this pinned release downloads CPM and external data unconditionally. This offline profile builds the library and nine original self-contained test executables; the full external-data developer matrix is not claimed.
Both shared and static consumers are rebuilt against every qualified installation prefix. Malformed JSON and nonexistent dispatch implementations must fail.
The original material profile, source archive, metadata.catalog and all original developer/tool sources remain available.
The API probe is C++17. Optional C++26 static reflection and external competitive parsing benchmarks are not qualified.
